recognize_zh: CD3 免疫染色中，大量小型 T 細胞呈細胞膜陽性並填滿濾泡間區，中間夾著數個 CD3 陰性（藍色）的小細胞區，對應 B 細胞濾泡或 B 細胞區；T 區擴張而結構保留，符合 EBV 再活化時的反應性副皮質增生。
features: Lymphoid tissue with numerous CD3-positive small T cells showing membranous staining
Intervening CD3-negative zones of small lymphocytes, consistent with B-cell areas or follicles
Positive cells are small and uniform without large atypical T cells evident at this power
Overall compartmentalization of T- and B-cell zones is preserved
describe_en: CD3 immunostain on lymphoid tissue shows numerous small T cells with membranous staining occupying expanded interfollicular and paracortical areas, separating CD3-negative zones of small lymphocytes that likely represent B-cell areas. The T cells are small and uniform without obvious large atypical forms at this magnification, and the compartmentalization of T- and B-cell zones is preserved. Findings are consistent with a reactive paracortical T-cell expansion, as seen in EBV reactivation, and do not by themselves indicate a T-cell lymphoma; EBER ISH and correlation with CD20, CD30 and clonality studies are required.

ddx.vs: PTCL effaces the architecture with atypical medium to large T cells, often with pan-T antigen loss and a clonal TCR rearrangement.
AITL shows expanded CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks, arborizing vessels and atypical PD-1/CD10-positive TFH cells, often with scattered EBV-positive B blasts.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells rosetted by T cells within an expanded interfollicular zone.
